left.text: Pip stayed on the dry bank. “The water makes me feel wobbly.” “We can sit here,” said his friend Rue.

right.text: Mama sat close by. Pip leaned toward the shallow edge. “Just one paw,” he said, and touched the cool water.

left.text: A little ripple tickled Pip’s paw. He pulled it back. Rue waited beside him. “We can stop,” she said.

right.text: Pip watched the water grow still. Then he dipped one paw again. “Look! I made a tiny circle.”

left.text: “I want to try a little splash,” said Pip. He stayed on the bank and patted the shallow water.

right.text: Pip splashed. Rue splashed beside him. “I still feel wobbly,” said Pip. “But I like playing right here.”
